projects.description: Magically Simple 2D & 3D Game Engine built on top of wgpu
evidence: 58 GitHub stars and 18 forks. These can be manipulated and are not proof of quality.
GitHub topics: 3d, game, game-engine, gamedev, graphics, hacktoberfest.

opportunity.reason: The repository declares early development and lists concrete unfinished work.

flags: More observations needed for view velocity

ranking.reason: Playable projects & game makers. Theme matching is based on repository metadata, not measured virality.
ranking.coverage: Source checks current · X reach unmeasured · GitHub momentum unmeasured · Instagram & TikTok unmeasured

factors.label: Source quality
factors.detail: License listed; README present; source present; tests present; CI present. Complete file listing checked. File presence does not prove working software or security.

factors.label: Active development
factors.detail: Fresh GitHub metadata and code pushed within 30 days. Activity in the last two days receives full credit; older activity decays.

factors.label: Adoption
factors.detail: Capped, logarithmic stars and forks. This measures repository adoption, not current virality. Popularity alone cannot earn an 80+ score.

factors.label: Demo & theme
factors.detail: Playable projects & game makers. Theme matching is based on repository metadata, not measured virality. An actual project demo is available.

factors.label: GitHub momentum
factors.detail: No fresh Trending placement or measured growth. Total stars do not earn momentum points.

factors.label: Social traction
factors.detail: Fresh, directly linked X posts: measured reach, distinct authors, recency and engagement. Missing views earn no points and are shown as unknown. Audiences are never added together.
